notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.notes:
After years in development, we are proud to call this update Version 1.0. Here are some of the major changes. Complete patch notes below...
Quests
You now have quests! Quests like “Kill enemies”, “Upgrade a weapon”, “Evolve DNA”, etc., award coins depending on the quest tier. Tier 1 quests give you 1000 coins, tier 2 quests give you 5000 coins, and tier 3 quests give you a bounty of 25000 coins!!! The Quest menu is in the bedroom and requires internet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/7cd34e7e57cc5b036367dd600ba7a1cbfaf04025.png

Light Sword Quest
You can now unlock a Light Saber via a new quest! The light saber replaces the existing saber and you can choose which saber to bring to the battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/8e8ac2dc305a0da7023b7fa1bc7481e9c964b267.png

Halloween and Christmas Events
We added Halloween and Christmas events! The Halloween event starts on October 15 while the Christmas event starts on December 15. Both events last 30 days. 

During the Halloween event, you’ll encounter our first mini-boss, the Witch. You’ll have a pumpkin pistol that does double damage to witches. You’ll have a tier 3 quest to “Kill 10 witches”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/8719ed7efe76f4ed84d1f0553e382d1817549732.png

During the Christmas event, a seasonal “Gift Drop” game mode is unlocked. Gift drop mode works like the “Air Drop” challenge mode where a random inventory mechanic makes each map a Rogue-lite mission. You go in with nothing and random ammo, traps, and towers drop from the air every minute. You can also find hidden gifts and chimneys in all maps. You’ll have a tier 3 quest to “Deliver 50 Gifts”. Plus, you’ll meet the Grinch mini-boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/10cdd13fbb1c75e4e145c938bef83e05d7bc74ce.png

Jitter Removal
As requested by the community, we added interpolation to remove jitter, everywhere. This was especially challenging on the boat and truck where enemies are pathing on a moving platform.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/5ea7fbe84fc26c856392fbfe4100602c008f70e2.gif

Our First Cutscene
We added our first cutscene to explain where the spores you are defending came from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/d94a9d28478cc41f1d597defa7d4b089822c6707.png

Dig Site Map
We’ve replaced the Hangar map with a more story-focused Dig site since the spores do come from underground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/60085e28949222e05359b96c2f8ad847dc6bf3bc.png

Updated Enemy Skins
The flying Cowboy and axe throwing Caveman have been replaced with the Raccoon and Turtle respectively. All enemies now have an animal theme with matching armor for a more cohesive look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/09b2d3c123a4dce6bce84006ce5c12430d9239f7.png


Patch Notes
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280290/discussions/0/6149189044492693132/

notes.title: DNA & Manual Reload Update
notes.notes:
DNA Feature
DNA are buffs you search for in-world or earn by completing missions. You evolve them from common to epic and install up to 3 of them. They are designed for you to select your playstyle. For example, a DPS soldier may use Weapon Gas Damage + Reload Speed + Range. A tank may use Player HP + Support DNA. A harvester may use Grappling range + Enemy coins DNA. A builder may use Tower Gas Damage + Tower HP DNA.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/6b9eba7ff8bc85d2353e83a224478496b94e9f7a.gif

Manual Reload
Manual reload is probably the most asked for feature and we finally implemented it. Since manual reload uses both hands, thereby losing the ability to dual-wield weapons, the DPS reward must be big. So, if you manually reload your weapon, you can continuously fire your weapon, unleashing a bullet storm onto enemies. Manually reloading a weapon also tops up the magazine so you never lose ammo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/cdffac637b22cefc386b15e0f79521f2c4f826c4.gif

The Anti Gravity Launcher
Introducing the first weapon found in-world, the Anti-gravity launcher. While searching for DNA, there’s a 25% chance you’ll find this powerful weapon. Send the mutants to space!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/b277083f32eb7ef68bf8bfe39945c16ede5ec51c.gif

Target Strong and Overcharge
Strategists can now program towers to target the strongest enemy. They also can overcharge towers. An overcharged tower gets ludicrous damage, range, and HP, until it self-destructs 45 seconds later.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/c64c8b38781a708b5e5859bc5d8ef4031a38f9ac.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/e0df27325287905d58fddcd6ec59ecda5485c144.jpg

Mid-air Explosions
Strategists can now explode arrows mid-air using the trigger! Just upgrade you bow to rare to get rid of those pesky flying cowboys!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/de01f3664c0ed56f66d7c99fddac365f955880f2.gif

New Main Menu
The new main menu has a bedroom where you select a hero, a big lab, and a terminal. At the center is a spore tree that shows you the number of spores you’ve collected by completing missions. The lab features 3D weapons and storage shelves and a DNA section where you can evolve and install DNA.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/7bab507fa1ae3d3bc8ad65be6ded75bc769a094f.jpg

Patch Notes 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1280290/discussions/0/3050611107171820630/#c3811786447114861857

notes.title: Spitter and Spores Update
notes.notes:
Spitter
The evil corporation replaced their grunt shooters with an army of mutant lizards. Their unique tail attack damages walls and they spit acid at you, but they have a weakness, the mind-altering spider on their backs! We replaced their health bar with damaged skin, gibs, roots, and minimal green blood for more immersion. Soon, all enemies will follow suit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/6e442b2e39508ee1573a722297bc9e4ca1e75f88.gif

Spores
Extraterrestrial spores are the key to accelerated evolution. Protect them at all costs! The crystal shows its damage through cracks but the green health bar on top and health indicator on the wristwatch remains the same.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/4bf16408082401d27e2d9d18d7b758451560a9c5.gif

Patch Notes
Version 0.3.3 - Regular update - 6/21/2022
New:
[olist]
	Lizard enemy "Spitter" replaces the basic shooter enemy.
	Spitters have impact effects: gibs, roots, and minimal blood.
	Spitter's skin shows its damage thus do not need health bars over their heads.
	Spitters have unique tail and spit attacks.
	Spitters have a mini-spider on their backs that do mega damage when shot.
	The enemy objective that used to be called "cache" is now called "spores".
	The spores have been beautified. Check it out!
	Path trails in Hangar and Orchard show the enemies' path to the spores.
	Added bullet hole decals and damage-proportional particle effects.
	Added bow and arrow training.
	Added freeze grenade training.
[/olist]
Balance changes:
[olist]
	Common electric pistol nerfed to hit 3 targets instead of 5. Rare and above are unchanged.
	Electric rifle range is now longer.
	Laser rifle and pistol will now pulse 8 times until it hits a target.
	Made electric rifle and grenade launcher bullets not collide with other bullets just like arrows.
	Grenade launcher rocket now lasts 8 seconds instead of 6.
	Attack City normal will now spawn 2 cowboys every 15 seconds after picking up objective.
	Players sometimes took fall damage when falling into water.
[/olist]
General:
[olist]
	Improved footsteps audio.
	Improved hand animations.
	Electric rifle, grenade launcher, and bow now take into account barrel velocity.
	Hovercrafts now break into pieces when destroyed.
	You can now grab wooden crates and propane tanks without telekinesis.
	Frozen enemies that will thaw soon now appear less frozen.
	Flying cowboys were taking a long time to find you if you're hidden.
	Visual tracer rounds used to overshoot its target.
	Statistics canvas will now follow you every 15 seconds instead of 20.
	It was possible to spawn an arrow and equip a weapon in the same hand.
	Loadout was not being saved right after combat phase. If a player quit game before loading the next scene, loadout would revert.
	Once you enter saber/freeze grenade tutorial, you now can't leave until completed.
	Running out of battery on right controller lead to not being able to press continue button.
	Added colliders in the city center for more immersion.
	Added colliders around the city so player can't go out-of-bounds.
	Renamed "Report bug" button to "Desktop menu".
	Updated credits screen in the desktop menu.
	Werewolf growls now have slight variations.
[/olist]

notes.title: Heroes Update
notes.notes:
Our female soldier has a fast-paced, action playstyle with a drastically shorter tutorial. She has more gun damage but traps and towers are more expensive. Our male strategist has a more relaxed, strategic playstyle. Although he is proficient with the saber and bow, his true strength lies in cheaper traps and towers.

The Soldier's arsenal includes loot found in-world: Freeze Grenades, Pet Hawks, and Berserk Injections!

Freeze Grenades
Freeze grenades, pets, and injections upgrade within the same mission depending how much you use them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/0abeb9163418b94c1c46ebd0ff7cc4983681f007.gif
Pet Hawks
Pets do physical damage to nearby enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/6b12291790b6d374487fff311fa841394c807126.gif
Berserk Injections
In berserk mode, you run faster, take no damage, punches are much stronger, and you gain the ultimate shockwave ability!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/60bf780b75c5e108772ec2b40fe5fc2a982f268b.gif
Soldier vs Strategist Comparison
Soldier:
[olist]
 Fast paced action playstyle
 Faster movement
 Grenades, Pets, and Injections
 More gun damage
 Faster re-spawn
 Expensive traps and towers
 Cannot build coin tower
 Short tutorial
[/olist]
Strategist:
[olist]
 Strategic playstyle
 Slower movement
 Turbo building
 More saber and bow damage
 Slower re-spawn
 Cheaper traps and towers
 Can build coin tower
 Full tutorial
[/olist]
Patch Notes
Version 0.3.1 - Major update - 11/10/2021
[olist]
	Both Soldier and Strategist can punch enemies and loot crates with their bare hands!!!
	Added freeze grenades
	Added pet hawk
	Added berserk injection
	Added a Soldier playable hero who specializes in guns and grenades!!!
		
		 Fast paced action playstyle.
		 Soldiers walk or run 50% faster.
		 Soldiers do 45% more gun damage.
		 Soldiers cannot build in the first 4 scenes. Instead, there are pre-built blueprints that they can repair.
		 Soldiers can find freeze grenades, attack pets, and berserk injections in wooden crates or drops from enemies.
		 Freeze grenades, pets, and injections upgrade within the same mission depending how much you use them.
		 Pets do physical damage to nearby enemies.
		 Frozen enemies take 50% more damage from any source.
		 In berserk mode, you run faster, take no damage, punches are much stronger, and you gain the ultimate shockwave ability!
		 Soldiers respawn after death faster.
		 Traps and Towers cost 25% more.
		 Soldiers cannot build the Coin tower.
		
	Added a Strategist playable hero who specializes in building towers and traps. The strategist's favorite weapons are the saber and bow and arrow.
		
		 Strategic playstyle.
		 Strategists walk or run slower.
		 Strategists do 45% more damage using Saber or Bow and Arrow.
		 Can build traps and towers in any mission.
		 Strategists have a turbo build button.
		 Traps and Towers are cheaper.
		 Strategists take longer to re-spawn.
		 Strategists can build a Coin tower.
		
	Re-vamped the tutorial!
		
		 Soldiers have a drastically shortened tutorial.
		 Strategists have a slightly shortened tutorial.
		 Added tutorial tasks (canvases and controller signs) to regular missions if the player hasn't achieved them.
		 Soldiers will be taken to the building tutorial if the player loads a mission requiring building.
		
	Balance changes:
		
		 Hanger now has 25% less enemies to make it easier for new players.
		
	"Attack the city" gets a new mission objective! You now must find the cache and kill all nearby enemies before proceeding to the extraction point on top of the tallest building.
	Added 50 and 100 meter circles to wristwatch. 50 meters is the definition of "nearby enemies".
	Upgraded the skin of the grenade launcher.
	Heads-up display messages are not head-locked anymore. They float in your field-of-view.*
	Added wave timers to your wristwatch.*
	Cache health is now on the minimap.*
	Player hit audio now only plays if health crosses a 5 percentile instead of every damage.*
	Increased "drag to stop" force so you stop more quickly.*
	Laser pistol and rifle get a 2nd and 3rd chance. If you miss, you can move the beam and the first enemy it hits will take decreased damage. 
	Introducing the Presenter, unlocking scenes, weapons, and traps are now more satisfying.
	Vastly improved loot pickup notification.
	Grapple swing force now diminishes as you get closer to the hook. This makes colliding with hovercrafts easier.
	Loading the Forest truck from save game sometimes resulted in floating floors and traps.
	Settings were not being saved if returning to the main menu from the options menu.
	Vive wands were not registering build button clicks sometimes. 
	Going backwards using arm locomotion and thumbstick-back was broken.
	Increased the cost of ammo. Soldiers should spend as much as strategists.
	Made it easier for players using teleport to climb up steps.
	Added "new" icons to the main and inventory menus.
	You can now only build 100 or 200 walls, floors, and ramps depending on the scene. Previously, it was unlimited.
	When placing the anti-air tower, green highlight now indicates forward direction.

[/olist]

notes.title: Bow and Arrow, Atmosphere, Mangroves, and Arm Swing update
notes.notes:
Bow and Arrow 
This two-handed weapon was a gift from the ancient Andromendans. Double the power means double the fun! Unlocked by completing Hangar in normal difficulty.
https://i.imgur.com/2KFgj2R.png
Atmosphere 
The best graphics cards deserve the best visuals. The changing weather adds tension and suspense, a sign of imminent danger. Currently, only the Orchard and River have atmosphere. This will soon be extended to all outdoor scenes.
https://i.imgur.com/fD4Zipb.png
Mangroves in the River 
All rivers should have mangroves. They just look so cool :).
https://i.imgur.com/aPrs0Zv.png

notes.title: City Map Update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year everybody! We've added 2 new defense sites in the Black Ghost City. There are now 4 sites: park, center, dead-end, and nightclub. They are randomly selected when you load the map. Dead-end and nightclub sites are only available on normal and hard difficulty. 

Here are the patch notes since the start of alpha 2 weeks ago:
[olist]
	City scene now has multiple defense sites: 2 on "easy", 4 on "normal" and "hard".
	Vive headset with Valve Index controllers now automatically detected. The launch option "-platform index" not needed.
	Added upgrading trap/tower sound fx.
	Fixed WMR and Vive Cosmos flickering on initial load.
	Lower back holster moved to chest holster making it easier for seated players.
	Improved saber interaction. Damage based on speed. Head hits work now too.
	Boat auto-pilot not engaging after using rudder and/or steering wheel
	Updated tutorial graphic and text to reflect lower back holster moved to chest. 
	Laser pistol is now more accurate at point blank range however scope is more sensitive to hand movement.
[/olist]
